01.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the attached sky texture 01. Asset type: a seamless 2:1 equirectangular full-sphere sky panorama for a warm coastal casual 3D mobile fishing game, 2048x1024 PNG.
Primary request: revise this sky texture to remove the overbright whitish horizon band and any horizontal cut line while retaining its soft stylized 3D cloud character.
Keep invariant: three large rounded cumulus groups, one low near the middle and one at each side, as in the reference; rich but moderate azure. Keep the familiar overall arrangement and rounded sculptural cloud shading. Clouds should stay in the UPPER hemisphere, between 20% and 43% image height. Leave the top 12% clear and smooth for the zenith pole. The panorama's true horizon is EXACTLY the horizontal centre, y=50%; this row must be medium-light pastel BLUE CYAN, roughly #83b9cf, with blue saturation clearly present, never near-white. Blend smoothly toward a deeper clean blue at the zenith. The ENTIRE LOWER hemisphere is a softly graded empty blue-cyan environment fill, smoothly continuous through the centre, with no cloud, no ocean depiction, no second horizon. Keep the bottom 12% nearly uniform in longitude for the nadir pole.
Lighting: restrained warm ivory cloud tops with blue-grey undersides, gentle sunny coastal atmosphere; no clipping or pure white glow. Clean polished European casual-game 3D art, softly rounded volumes, no photographic detail.
Technical constraints: precise wide 2:1 image, horizontally seamless left and right with the same colour and gradient; no abrupt brightness strip at any latitude, no visible sun/disc, no mountains, islands, land, water, boats, UI, labels, border or watermark. Preserve the 360-degree environment-map purpose, not a landscape picture.

Make all three cloud groups about 25% smaller and lift them fully into the upper half: every cloud including its blue underside must fit between y=15% and y=43% of the image height. In particular move the central cloud upward so its lowest point is above y=43%. Keep left / centre / right ordering and the centre slightly lower than the sides. From y=45% all the way to the bottom must be entirely cloud-free clean smooth blue-cyan sky fill. The actual horizon is y=50%, blue cyan, never a white strip, no ocean or land or sun or extra objects. Keep both lateral edges seamless and both pole bands uniform in longitude. Change nothing else.
